title: Digit sum
goal:
Before: returns the sum of the decimal digits of n, and 0 for a negative n (123 → 6, 10 → 1, -123 → 0).
Change: a negative n is now summed by its digits as well, as if it were positive (-123 → 6); nothing else changes.
Constraints: do not change the loop body or the line m = n;, and the while condition must still compare against 10.

keep.desc: constraint 1: the loop body is unchanged (sum = sum + abs(m) % 10; m = m / 10;)
constraint 2: the while condition still compares against 10
constraint 3: the line m = n; is unchanged
